publisher.name: Boatify Rentals LLC
publisher.commercial_disclosure: Maintainer owns the paid Actors and can receive eligible usage revenue.

transport.authentication: Caller-managed secure Apify OAuth or Authorization header

capabilities.intent: Are there source-dated recent live openings at this supplied company?
capabilities.delivers: Evidence-backed job records with date meanings and explicit coverage status

company_website.title: Company website (required)
company_website.description: Public company domain or URL. One company per report. We follow its careers/ATS links; no source credentials needed. Do not supply an ATS URL directly.

lookback_days.title: Lookback days (optional)
lookback_days.description: Default 30. UTC calendar-day window; only source-verifiable publication dates qualify. Republication is explicitly labeled.

max_jobs.title: Maximum jobs (advanced)
max_jobs.description: Default 30; output cap 1–100. Partial positives cost one report; complete dated negatives also cost one report. Unknown/failed checks are free. Raising this cap does not increase the 40-request budget.

capabilities.intent: Which public contact routes are advertised on this supplied business website?
capabilities.delivers: Page-observed public email, phone, contact and booking routes with evidence

input_schema.title: Website Contact Finder — Email, Phone & Booking

company_website.title: Company website
company_website.description: The business's official public HTTPS website.

capabilities.intent: What plans and prices does this vendor display on its official pricing pages?
capabilities.delivers: Source-backed pricing snapshots for competitive research and change comparisons.

input_schema.title: SaaS Pricing Plans & Prices — Verified Reports
input_schema.description: Supply one public company website. An explicit pricing URL is optional.

company_website.title: Company website
company_website.description: Public SaaS company domain or HTTPS URL, for example linear.app.

pricing_url.title: Pricing page URL (optional)
pricing_url.description: Public pricing page on the same registrable company domain. If omitted, the Actor follows a pricing link on the homepage or tries /pricing.

capabilities.verification_scope: A plan and displayed price are associated in the same checked source. Currency symbols and billing periods are preserved as stated.
capabilities.coverage_limits: Static extraction is not an exhaustive catalog. Regional prices, tax, discounts, add-ons and dynamic widgets may remain unknown. Do not infer an ISO currency from a symbol.
capabilities.request_bounds: 8 requests, 8 MB total, 3 MB per page, 35-second network budget.

capabilities.intent: What price and stock evidence is published for this product and its observed variants?
capabilities.delivers: Commerce agents can compare dated offers and refresh availability before recommending a product.

input_schema.title: Product Price & Stock Availability — Verified
input_schema.description: Supply one public product URL. Variant-level availability is returned only when published by the retailer.

product_url.title: Public product URL
product_url.description: HTTPS URL for one product page, not a collection, search, cart, or account page.

capabilities.verification_scope: Checked product structured data and supported public variant metadata. Product-group and variant offers retain distinct scope.
capabilities.coverage_limits: Group stock does not prove every variant is available. Missing variant price stays null; regional checkout price and purchase completion are not tested.
capabilities.request_bounds: 3 requests, 4 MB total, 3 MB per page, 20-second network budget.

capabilities.intent: Which named customer stories does this vendor publish on its official website?
capabilities.delivers: Find case-study evidence for vendor qualification and account research.

input_schema.title: Customer Case Studies — Verified Customer Proof

company_website.title: Official company website
company_website.description: One public, official company domain or HTTPS URL. The Actor follows same-company customer stories only.

max_customers.title: Maximum verified customers
max_customers.description: Return at most this many verified story rows. Unverifiable links do not consume this limit; all checks remain within the request and time budget. The result is not exhaustive.

capabilities.verification_scope: Named customers and stories verified on vendor-linked first-party case-study pages.
capabilities.coverage_limits: These are vendor-published claims, not independent endorsements or proof the relationship is current. Generic logo walls alone are insufficient.
capabilities.request_bounds: 12 requests, 10 MB total, 3 MB per page, 45-second network budget.

capabilities.intent: Does this vendor publish a B2B partner program, and what next-step links are visible?
capabilities.delivers: Find official channel, solution and integration partnership routes.

input_schema.title: Partner Program Finder — Verified B2B Evidence

company_website.title: Official company website
company_website.description: One public official company domain or HTTPS URL. The Actor checks only linked same-company partner-program pages.

capabilities.verification_scope: Explicit B2B program evidence in vendor-linked official pages, including program types when stated.
capabilities.coverage_limits: Observed application links are not submitted; eligibility, benefits and acceptance are not inferred.
capabilities.request_bounds: 8 requests, 7 MB total, 3 MB per page, 35-second network budget.

capabilities.intent: Does this vendor officially document this named integration?
capabilities.delivers: Check a precise integration claim before recommending a vendor.

company_website.title: Official company website
company_website.description: One public official HTTPS company website; the Actor follows only linked same-company integration pages.

integration_name.title: Integration name
integration_name.description: One exact software or app name to check, such as GitHub or Salesforce.

capabilities.verification_scope: Official linked documentation explicitly identifies the requested integration.
capabilities.coverage_limits: Documentation does not establish a working connection, authentication, plan entitlement or current endpoint behavior.
capabilities.request_bounds: 8 requests, 7 MB total, 3 MB per page, 35-second network budget.

usage_boundary: No discovery of companies, people identity/deliverability verification, proof of buying intent, outreach, top-ups, subscriptions or recurring purchases.
